notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP (curl_cffi, chrome124 impersonation) succeeded for robots.txt (200, no Disallow for target paths; ClaudeBot listed with Crawl-delay:5 only, no blanket disallow) and for all category-landing pages (200, SSR mega-menu nav with full site-wide bed-bath/kitchen-dining/home-decor/home-improvement/outdoor-living/luggage-backpacks subcategory tree present in raw HTML). TREE: built via union of (1) SSR mega-menu flyout on the Home dept landing page (id=22672, canonical redirects to id=173142, title "Home Store: Decor & Furniture for the Home"), (2) each category landing page own in-page subcategory link strip (same global Home secondary-nav present on every page, confirmed identical across bedding/bath/kitchen/dining/home-decor/furniture-mattress/outdoor-living/luggage pages), (3) deeper drill-down fetches of every group node (organization-storage, kitchen organization, utility, area-rugs by-room/by-type, bedding essentials/baby-nursery, bath towels/shower-accessories, window-treatments, pillows-throw-blankets, table-linens, outdoor accessories-decor) to capture their own child leaves. Facet/filter-style URLs (Color_normal, Fabric, Material, Business_category, Furniture_category, Furniture_room, Rug_size, Price, Special_offers, Product_department, by-pattern/by-price/by-shape/by-size under area-rugs) were excluded as non-navigational query filters, not genuine category pages, consistent across the site. QTY: tier (a) HTML has no product count (client-hydrated after load), so escalated to tier (b) Playwright (headless chromium, domcontentloaded + fixed wait, per-page H1 + parenthesized count captured, canonical H1 checked against requested node on every leaf). Where Macys displays an exact number e.g. "(148)" that exact int was recorded with evidence citing the header text. Where Macys caps display at "(500+)" the site is NOT showing an exact count, so qty=null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag citing the capped text and confirmed H1, per the no-estimate rule. EXCLUDED (neither Textile nor Storage): curtain/shower-curtain hardware (hooks, rods, liners), Bath Accessories (mixed non-textile hardware), Napkin Rings, Window Treatments Hardware, Rug Pads, Kitchen Paper Towel Holders, Kitchen Lunch Bags & Boxes (personal-carry, not home storage), Ladders & Step Stools, Home Safety (safes/security-locks/safety-equipment-gear, despite being nested under Organization & Storage nav - primary purpose is security not storage), Outdoor Umbrellas, and all Furniture/Mattress/Lighting/Home-Appliances/Luggage/Wall-Decor/Kitchenware nodes (out of scope per category boundary rules). Furniture-adjacent storage nodes (wardrobes, dressers, chests, bookcases, TV units) are explicitly under the Furniture & Mattresses nav branch on this site, so excluded from Storage per storage.md SS21/27. LOW/MEDIUM confidence flags applied to: Blinds & Shades (LOW, mixed fabric/non-fabric materials), Poufs (MEDIUM, furniture/textile boundary), Luxury Bedding and Designer Rugs & Collaborations (MEDIUM, merchandising-tier categories that still sell genuine textile products), Baby Sleeping Bag (MEDIUM, wearable-vs-bedding boundary), Wall Hooks & Racks (MEDIUM, storage-vs-decor boundary). No blocks encountered; all pages returned 200.
